description.p: Sitak prepares and stacks astrophotography frames using the Siril 1.4.5 processing engine. It accepts session folders and 7z archives, and can export FITS, standard 32-bit TIFF, or a mobile-ready stretched 16-bit TIFF.
Mobile TIFF uses a linked SDR auto-stretch and lossless Adobe Deflate compression for viewing, sharing, and basic phone editing. Sitak is a command-line application for Linux.
Adds mobile-ready 16-bit stretched TIFF export with lossless Deflate compression; preserves the existing linear TIFF and FITS export choices.
